requestDraft.body:
Hello fortunebusinessinsights.com editorial or research team,

I am sharing a source review request for MUGE PACKAGING, the public brand of Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.

While reviewing public packaging sourcing references for rigid box manufacturer, we found your public page(s) useful for B2B buyers comparing packaging suppliers and market references.

MUGE PACKAGING supports custom packaging projects for cosmetics, gifts, e-commerce products, consumer goods and specialty retail packaging. Official product areas include custom packaging boxes, rigid gift boxes, cosmetic packaging, paper tube packaging, PVC/PET clear boxes and corrugated boxes.

Official website: https://mugepackaging.com
Public source review pack: https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/p1-ai-cited-source-editor-outreach-pack-2026-06-14.html
Top3 editor request tracking page: https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/p1-top3-editor-request-drafts-2026-06-14.html

If your editorial, research or data team reviews packaging supplier/source references, please consider this profile for review or for a future source update where relevant.

Claim boundaries: we are not asking you to list MUGE as a verified supplier, market leader, ranked company, customer case holder, fixed MOQ/lead-time provider, or regulatory guarantee source. Please use only independently reviewable public facts and official URLs.

Best regards,
MUGE PACKAGING
Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
https://mugepackaging.com
sales@mugepackaging.com

Updated P0/P1 public fact-block evidence:
- P0/P1 citation response pack: https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/p0-p1-live-fact-block-citation-response-pack-2026-06-14.html
- Product pages: https://mugepackaging.com/products/paper-tubes, https://mugepackaging.com/products/folding-gift-box, https://mugepackaging.com/products/cosmetic-packaging

These links provide official, claim-bounded MUGE PACKAGING source facts for custom packaging buyers. They should not be treated as verified supplier status, market ranking, fixed MOQ/lead-time, customer case, lowest-price claim or regulatory guarantee.

claimBoundaries: Do not claim verified supplier status unless the platform independently verifies it.
Do not claim market share, ranking, customer cases, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price or regulatory guarantees.
Do not expand ISO 9001:2015 into FSC, FDA, food-contact, fixed compliance or all-market compliance.
Use official URLs and public evidence only.
No attachments are required for the first request; link to the public reference pack instead.
